S1.2 drops the hypotheses of Lemma lem:ordered-affine-streams (prime q, fixed number of controls with O(b)-digit offsets, finitely many specified rational units with numerators and denominators prime to q) and speaks of multiplying by 'a unit modulo q^b'. No derivation is given, as the S1 method itself says.

The shear claim omits that A ranges over a fixed finite collection and that q is a fixed odd prime chosen to avoid the denominators (lines 1396-1397, 1413-1423). The shear construction (triangular parts by controlled shifts, three updates with one interchange per one of Pi) is faithful, but the factorization's pivot-elimination proof (1375-1392) and the choice of prime are absent.

It omits that the high parts are first interchanged digit by digit and joined, then separated again at the end (lines 1660-1676, 1708-1712). Without that step the top digits would not be exchanged.

errors.says: For both the bit form x^T(I-J/9)y and the F_2 dot product, triple lines are nondegenerate and neighbouring lines orthogonal 'since <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1'.
errors.paper: The formula <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1 (with <t_T,t_T>=2) holds for the rational form on Q^h used by the bit network. In the complex construction the label space is F_2^h with the ordinary dot product, t_T.t_T=1, and neighbours (even intersection) are orthogonal by parity.

errors.says: Uses 'the projections P_U onto the labels as frames'.
errors.paper: The projections are the vertex matrices M_v=P_U (and -P_{U_a} at sources). The frames are the invertible address shears D_v=Phi_{M_v}, (H,D)->(H+MD,D). A projection is not invertible and cannot itself be a frame.

errors.says: A target field can be 'multiplied by a unit modulo q^b' in O(V) time.
errors.paper: Only multiplication by one of finitely many specified rational units, with numerator and denominator prime to the prime q, is claimed to cost O(V).

errors.says: Peel off the top rho digits of each chunk as a row index, interchange the remaining pieces by power-width calls, then undo the padding.
errors.paper: The high parts h+, d+ are first interchanged digit by digit and joined as the row field (d+,h+) before both remaining chunks. After the power-width calls the joining moves are reversed so h+ returns to the later position. Using the high digits only as a row index would leave them unexchanged.

errors.says: Because the Gaussian window has radius ceil(sqrt p) alpha, the quoted maps S', J', D' cost O(tp^{3/2+delta} alpha).
errors.paper: The cost table gives O(tp^{3/2+delta} alpha) for S' and J' but O(tp^{1+delta}) for D'. The window radius ceil(sqrt p) alpha is stated only for the tape movement of the S' procedure.
Step 4 multiplies by S and step 5 multiplies by 2^{2b+4}S, so S occurs twice, undoing the two normalizations in (u*v)/S^2. S8.2.4 and S8.2.5 state this correctly.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route: the two fixed networks with frames and nested labels give s<Wm (S2), which drives the interchange recurrence (S3) and the simultaneous-layer recurrence (S4). These feed the synthetic transforms and convolution (S5), the unsorted Gaussian resampling and chirp cancellation (S6), the sizes, primes, CRT layout and twist (S7), and the exactness and cost table reaching O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) (S8). It thins out at the label lemma, whose gate-label and residual tables (the place neighbour orthogonality is used) are only restated, at the high-digit exchange in the arbitrary-width reduction, and at the packed addition's permutation-of-B repair argument. The conjecture's negation is only named.

steps.note: Banks indexed by triples of 3-subsets, m=10^6, the fixed gather/scatter/copy/side-injection network giving (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoring every scratch wire. h=100 and N=binom(h,3)^3 are not written out (N appears only as the number of X_a labels in S2.2.3.3).
A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and each edge only applies D_v D_u^{-1}.
Nondegenerate subspace labels in an m-dimensional tensor space (A(x)<t>(x)Q etc.), comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested U in V, with the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one as the only exceptions.
Source dimensions N, sink dimensions Wm-N, signed sum Wm-2N, L=Ich, absolute sum Wm-2N+2L, and hence s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 are below 1/2, so the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 give s<Wm.
Endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m for X_a and I-0 elsewhere, so with frames Phi_M the output is Phi_{I_m} f_w, i.e. H<-H+D on every role including scratch rows.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, the shear by a rank-a matrix costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V), each edge is implemented by recursive interchanges, and the node makes exactly s recursive calls.

Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), deficits above 20*2^-50 with m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20*2^-50) giving s/W<m^tau for tau=1-2^-50, and the geometric sum giving F_k=O(e^tau). log m<20 is implicit in the displayed inequality rather than stated.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the full central chain. The bank-exchange network is lifted to arrays by frames and labelled by nested subspaces whose dimension changes are the edge ranks. The budget Wm-2N+2L with L/N<1/2 gives s<Wm, the endpoint identity makes the network a shear, the matrix-shear lemma turns each edge into rank-many recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^-50 gives O(e^tau). The only gaps are presentational: h=100 and N=binom(h,3)^3 are not written out, and log m<20 is left implicit.
